newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Mary El ministry opposes Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Mary El ministry opposes Eurobond.

text.p: The Finance Ministry in Russia's Mary El republic opposes a Eurobond issue by the territory as it may be risky for the local budget, a Mary El Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
"We are one of the republics which receives monetary support from the federal budget," Vera Kurbatova, chief economist of the ministry's market structure department, told Reuters.
"As a Finance Ministry we are against it, as we do not have enough backing. We cannot risk the budget."

Earlier Russian Finance Ministry's securities department head Bella Zlatkis mentioned Mary El as one of the republics planning a Eurobond issue. But she also said territories receiving monetary assistance from the federal government cannot issue Eurobonds.
Kurbatova said the Eurobond issue was the initiative of a local bank.
President Boris Yeltsin said in his March state of the nation address that the federal government would not be responsible for foreign borrowing by the regions not approved by Moscow.
